ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels accounting for approximately 98% of the surface area, with sparse high-intensity white pixels forming small clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark low-intensity field with discrete, non-contiguous high-contrast white focal points scattered across both lobes; no large-scale geometric banding or mottling is observed.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65-70 degrees, creating a symmetrical bifurcation of the central fluke region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; a notable increase in pixel-amplitude variation is visible on the distal section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally convex curve from the median notch to the terminal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (1-4 pixel diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, representing localized depigmentation or scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular, ragged tissue loss on the distal tip of the right lobe; numerous small circular white scars consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites are visible across the surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive, jagged necrotic-looking edge on the far right tip of the fluke, characterized by significant irregular pixel-level variations compared to the more uniform left tip.
